familySummary: Wooly pillows offer a simple white look in a practical rectangular shape, suited to everyday bedroom styling and relaxed layering.
familyDescription: The Wooly family brings a clean, understated look to pillow styling with a white finish and a classic rectangular profile. It works well as a calm base in bedrooms and can be paired easily with other soft furnishings. This pillow measures 60 × 50 × 12 cm and is made from Cotton, Wool. Its familiar shape and neutral colour make it an easy choice for beds, sofas or seating areas where a simple textile accent is wanted.
